name: Agent Ready Armor
tagline: Agent controls on the host, from reusable methods to accepted results.
summary: ARA runs supervised agents directly on the host, without a separate VM or container. Reusable equipment and persistent records remain separate from worker and model choices. Operators use Armory, CLI commands, and implemented HTTP actions; worker clients use MCP or session IPC. Native and supported runtime controls govern operations, while evidence checks and operator sign-off govern accepted output.

controlSummary: Control in Depth starts where supported calls reach files, executables, and network destinations. Policy and task gates add engagement conditions and progress obligations. Model guidance, evidence, and operator review connect permitted work to accepted output.

controlLayers.title: Installed Linux network filter
controlLayers.boundary: Selected network syscall forms in the launched child and descendants.
controlLayers.mechanism: A real seccomp filter requests decisions for connect and destination-bearing sendto; it denies io_uring_setup.
controlLayers.prevents: A denied selected syscall cannot continue through this notification response.
controlLayers.activation: Containment, the enforcement flag, accepted platform screening, successful installation, and listener attachment. Armory requests this by default for task runs.
controlLayers.attempt: A trapped connect targets an IP outside the projected allowlist.
controlLayers.decision: Allow rules precede deny rules. An unmatched IP or unreadable destination denies unless fail-open is enabled. Installation failure can continue without this filter.

controlLayers.title: Native file and directory access
controlLayers.boundary: Supported libc file, navigation, and permission calls.
controlLayers.mechanism: The loaded shim resolves the path and checks its cached projected denial rules before the original call.
controlLayers.prevents: A matching live denial stops that supported operation with EACCES.
controlLayers.activation: The process loads the library and completes the supervisor handshake; relevant rules apply and shadow mode is off.
controlLayers.attempt: A wrapped open targets /workspace/private/credentials.json under a matching deny rule.
controlLayers.decision: The wrapper returns failure before the real open. Unmatched paths and failed canonicalization proceed. The native cache comes from the initial handshake.

controlLayers.title: Native executable boundary
controlLayers.boundary: Supported exec wrappers in a process that loads the shim.
controlLayers.mechanism: The shim matches command forms, executable paths, and selected path-like operands before real execution.
controlLayers.prevents: A matching command or protected operand denial stops that wrapped execution with EACCES.
controlLayers.activation: Loaded supervised shim, applicable cached rule, and live enforcement. Supported wrappers restore the child preload environment.
controlLayers.attempt: A proposed executable or file operand matches a protected rule.
controlLayers.decision: The gate returns before the real exec call. Unmatched execution proceeds. This path does not send a task-budget query for every native exec.

controlLayers.title: Native IP destination boundary
controlLayers.boundary: Wrapped IPv4 and IPv6 connect calls.
controlLayers.mechanism: The shim checks the resolved numeric IP and port against cached allow and deny rules.
controlLayers.prevents: A matching deny or active unmatched-default deny stops real_connect.
controlLayers.activation: Loaded shim and live enforcement. ARA_SHIM_NET_ENFORCE activates unmatched denial; Armory defaults it to 1 for tasks.
controlLayers.attempt: A wrapped connection targets 198.51.100.77:443 outside the projected allowlist.
controlLayers.decision: Allow matches win first. Deny then returns EACCES. Without the unmatched-denial flag, a local miss is permitted and audited. Unix sockets generally pass.

controlLayers.title: Node resource hooks
controlLayers.boundary: Supported Node filesystem, HTTP, and socket APIs.
controlLayers.mechanism: Armed hooks check local projected resource rules before the original JavaScript API.
controlLayers.prevents: A local matching denial rejects the file call or emits a network error before the original operation.
controlLayers.activation: Node guard import, accepted handshake, supported hooked API, applicable rule, and shadow mode off.
controlLayers.attempt: A supported Node file read names a path in the local deny set.
controlLayers.decision: The hook rejects the call. Local misses generally proceed with best-effort audit. Node can receive rule updates; network allows precede denies.

controlLayers.title: Node asynchronous child process
controlLayers.mechanism: The wrapper waits for a supervisor query result before the original spawn.
controlLayers.prevents: A nonallow response or query failure prevents that asynchronous child from starting.
controlLayers.activation: Armed guard and the applicable asynchronous wrapper.
controlLayers.attempt: A supported spawn receives a supervisor deny decision.
controlLayers.decision: The wrapper reports an error without the original spawn. CommonJS synchronous process wrappers only audit and propagate environment; ESM synchronous variants use local checks.

controlLayers.title: Python task subprocess boundary
controlLayers.boundary: Python subprocess.Popen under the task bootstrap.
controlLayers.mechanism: The wrapper sends exec.spawn before the original Popen constructor.
controlLayers.prevents: A nonallow result, invalid decision, or transport exception prevents that process launch.
controlLayers.activation: Python bootstrap imports successfully; transcript protocol is v1 and a task identifier is present. This is the default Hermes task integration.
controlLayers.attempt: The task supervisor is unavailable when Hermes proposes a subprocess.
controlLayers.decision: The wrapper raises PermissionError before the original Popen call. Non-task launches do not activate this Python pre-spawn gate.

controlLayers.title: Proxy connection policy
controlLayers.boundary: CONNECT traffic that actually uses the session proxy.
controlLayers.mechanism: The proxy checks applicable network allows before network denies, before upstream tunneling.
controlLayers.prevents: A matched denial returns HTTP 403 without the upstream tunnel.
controlLayers.activation: Session proxy active, client uses it, and an applicable network deny matches without an allow match.
controlLayers.attempt: A proxied CONNECT asks for a denied target.
controlLayers.decision: The proxy stops before upstream. Unmatched connections pass. Blind tunnels do not inspect encrypted model content; direct traffic needs its other network controls.

controlLayers.title: Scoped operation policy
controlLayers.boundary: Queries submitted by a participating consumer.
controlLayers.mechanism: Bulwark selects scoped deny, approval, and allow rules; the supervisor composes further gates.
controlLayers.prevents: A final deny prevents an operation when the querying consumer applies that result.
controlLayers.activation: A query reaches the supervisor, relevant rules apply, and the final observation or approval settings retain the denial.
controlLayers.attempt: A Python task exec.spawn query matches a global deny.
controlLayers.decision: The general evaluator gives deny precedence and permits unmatched queries. Final shadow conversion permits denies except recognized irreversible danger. Local projections have separate contracts.

controlLayers.title: Engagement operating contract
controlLayers.boundary: Applicable supervisor queries with an active Trim view.
controlLayers.mechanism: The runtime composes time windows, stop latch, classification policy, and rate conditions.
controlLayers.prevents: A denied operating condition can tighten an otherwise permitted query.
controlLayers.activation: Active armor and Trim, applicable nonexempt query, successful evaluation, and effective final enforcement setting.
controlLayers.attempt: A classified active tool is proposed for a passive engagement.
controlLayers.decision: The Trim decision denies. Missing Trim or evaluation errors retain prior policy. Queue delays are returned by the API but not slept by the current supervisor.

controlLayers.title: Task continuity and progress
controlLayers.boundary: Queried target exec.spawn and browser.nav actions.
controlLayers.mechanism: Persisted task state checks loadout hashes and commit, branch, verification, or blocked phases.
controlLayers.prevents: A missing run, changed loadout, or outstanding obligation can hold the next applicable target action.
controlLayers.activation: Task identifier, classified target query, prior allow, and live final query enforcement.
controlLayers.attempt: A task proposes its next process while commit_required is persisted.
controlLayers.decision: TASK_COMMIT_REQUIRED becomes deny; the Python consumer raises before Popen. Network connections and HTTP requests do not spend this action budget.

controlLayers.title: Chunk and typed channel authority
controlLayers.boundary: Runtime channel dispatch and store mutation.
controlLayers.mechanism: The dispatcher checks registration, active tool_surface, task transition rules, caller role, and body schema.
controlLayers.prevents: An unavailable channel or invalid input is rejected before channel execution.
controlLayers.activation: Mounted engagement and a channel request through the supervisor or its typed interface.
controlLayers.attempt: An agent requests an existing channel outside the active chunk surface.
controlLayers.decision: tool_not_in_surface rejects the call. The supervisor fixes the caller as agent; body fields cannot grant the operator role. This surface governs channels, not all shell programs.

controlLayers.title: Supported model message decisions
controlLayers.boundary: Selected proxy model traffic and loaded Python OpenAI SDK request wrappers.
controlLayers.mechanism: Applicable rules can deny a request before upstream or replace a supported reply; SDK deny returns a synthetic completion.
controlLayers.prevents: The denied supported request is not sent through its original upstream call.
controlLayers.activation: Intercepted provider and supported format, or active SDK wrapper. Proxy use, trust configuration, and interception settings determine coverage.
controlLayers.attempt: A supported Python chat completion receives a request deny.
controlLayers.decision: The wrapper returns a synthetic completion. Task transcript transport failure denies; non-task failure and malformed decision fall-through permit. Node fetch capture discards decisions.

controlLayers.title: Identity and method guidance
controlLayers.boundary: Supported system and message envelopes supplied to the model.
controlLayers.mechanism: ABSOLUTE composes selected identity and hardening; the chunk brief explains current channels and exits.
controlLayers.prevents: It directs the model toward the selected task method; resource and channel gates perform their separate denials.
controlLayers.activation: Supported rewrite or brief path, selected equipment, and the relevant request format.
controlLayers.attempt: The model prepares its next action from the current chunk context.
controlLayers.decision: The model receives method and scope instructions. This guidance does not itself return EACCES for a file or network call.

controlLayers.title: Observation and comparison
controlLayers.boundary: Supported transcript, evidence, shadow, canary, and gateway capture paths.
controlLayers.mechanism: Capture stores observed content; shadows supply alternate outputs; canaries identify marked reply content.
controlLayers.prevents: Observation supplies review evidence. Capture alone does not prevent the original resource operation.
controlLayers.activation: Relevant capture integration or configured comparison. Gateway traffic needs its protocol-specific path.
controlLayers.attempt: A Node fetch hook captures a model request and receives an interception result.
controlLayers.decision: That hook discards the decision before its original fetch. Other applicable request gates retain their own behavior.

controlLayers.title: Finding acceptance contract
controlLayers.mechanism: Validators inspect applicable schema, references, captured content, lifecycle, explanation, and remediation conditions.
controlLayers.prevents: A failed sign-off check prevents the signed_off record from being appended.
controlLayers.activation: Sign-off request for an eligible finding, valid operator caller, and the relevant validation context.
controlLayers.attempt: A draft lacks the evidence or content needed for sign-off.
controlLayers.decision: The channel raises a rejection before the state transition. Reports use signed-off findings; validation does not undo earlier operations.

controlLayers.title: Operator permission and accepted output
controlLayers.boundary: Authenticated configuration, explicit approval policy, and operator-only review channels.
controlLayers.mechanism: The operator selects scope, equipment, enforcement settings, approval automation, and finding acceptance.
controlLayers.prevents: Caller restrictions keep agent channel messages from performing operator-only sign-off.
controlLayers.activation: Protected control-plane access, host permissions, and caller assignment through the supported interfaces.
controlLayers.attempt: An agent submits finding.sign_off through its channel connection.
controlLayers.decision: The agent caller fails allowed_callers. Operation approvals use the selected branch: human resolution, configured routine auto-grant, or task danger attestation.
